label: Terrain Run
description: A car defined by what it IS and what it is driving through, rather than by a named model: an archetype on a surface, with the surface written all over it. Reaches vehicle/car/archetype and vehicle/terrain, the two sections the vehicle family added and never used.
prefix: An automotive action photograph of ({archetype}:1.3), working ({terrain}:1.3).
suffix: Automotive Rendering: (the surface written onto the car — packed, thrown, filmed or polished exactly as that terrain does it:1.3), (suspension loaded and the body attitude honest to the speed:1.25), (correct panel gaps, accurate glass reflections, real tyre sidewall deformation:1.25), material separation between paint, rubber, glass and dirt, (tack-sharp vehicle:1.2).
negative: clean showroom car, floating, incorrect wheel count, deformed body, watermark, text, logo
